verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API and docs cover company/employee onboarding building blocks (company details, employee tax info configuration, multi-location/department setup) and even ship an official MCP server letting AI agents like Claude/Cursor call the API directly, which supports agent-driven onboarding. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a full employee+compensation creation endpoint sequence, so end-to-end 'onboard a new hire' via API is inferred rather than directly demonstrated.
